**NON–ABELIAN REIDEMEISTER TORSION FOR TWIST KNOTS**

*J ÉR ÔME DUBOIS, VU HUYNH, AND YOSHIKAZU YAMAGUCHI*

36 pp, 20 sections.

**Abstract.** This paper gives an explicit formula for the SL 2(C)−non–abelian Reidemeister torsion as deﬁned in [Dub06] in the case of twist knots. For hy perbolic twist knots, we also prove that the non–abelian Reidemeister torsion at the holonomy representation can be expressed as a rational function evaluated at the cusp shape of the knot. 1. I ntroduction Twist knots form a family of special two–bridge knots which i nclude the trefoil knot and the ﬁgure eight knot. The knot group of a two–bridge knot h as a particularly nice presentation with only two generators and a single relation . One could ﬁnd our interest in this family of knots in the following facts: ﬁrst, twist kn ots except the trefoil knot are hyperbolic; and second, twist knots are not ﬁbered except th e trefoil knot and the ﬁgure eight knot (see Remark 2 of the present paper for details).
